title: A refund rule that mints money
violates: A refund never creates money: the total after the refund is at most the total before, `total′ ≤ total`.
because: The clamp keeps the merchant's balance at zero instead of rejecting a refund above it, so the customer is credited in full while the merchant gives less.
class: a clamp where a rejection belongs

cured_by.text: Reject a refund above the merchant's balance, so that the debit equals the credit.

also.caption: A patch that rejects only the smallest overdrawing refund leaves another witness: it fixes the instance and not the class.
The rule that rejects a refund above the merchant's balance has no witness.
